title: Lentil Wrap
description: A simple and healthy wrap filled with lentils and spices. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cumin and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the lentil mixture onto the tortilla and serve.
